nom: TULA Brightening Treatment Drops Triple Vitamin C Serum

segments.oily: Some oily-skinned reviewers report the serum feels light, non-greasy and one notes fewer breakouts and reduced oiliness over time, though one recommends oily/greasy skin use it only at night.
segments.dry: Dry-skinned reviewers describe the serum as hydrating and say it eased dryness on the forehead and improved a long-standing dry-skin problem, though a few unrelated reviewers report new dryness and flaking after use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided group: several describe severe reactions (burning, swelling, itchy red skin, eczema-like rash around eyes and lips), while others with self-described sensitive skin call it a holy-grail staple with no irritation.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 40s-50s report brighter, more youthful-looking, smoother skin and reduced dullness, with no reactions mentioned in this group.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing her skin as extremely normal and non-reactive reports an unexpected dry, flaky, bump-causing reaction.
segments.combination: No combination-skin-specific reports are present in these reviews.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report brighter, smoother, more youthful-looking skin and reduced dullness; one reviewer specifically bought it for fine lines and dark spots and saw no visible change after one bottle.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report hydrated, softer, less dry-feeling skin after use; conversely several reviewers report the product itself caused dryness, flakiness and tightness as a reaction.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the serum reduced redness in their skin over time; others, especially with sensitive skin, report the product caused new redness, irritation or a burning sensation, including on daily use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing eczema-like, flaky, swollen or itchy rash-type reactions around the eyes, lips and forehead attribute this to the product; this is reported specifically in a subset of sensitive or reactive skin.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, age spots and acne marks with continued use; one reviewer saw no fading of dark spots and another saw no improvement in hyperpigmentation after two weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in acne scars or ongoing acne; one reviewer with sensitive skin reports the product caused whiteheads despite not being normally acne-prone, and others report burns and breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of oily-skin reviewers report the serum feels non-greasy and one felt her skin became less oily over time; no reports of the product increasing oiliness.

extraits.titre: Caused a dry/red/flaky reaction on non sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I am not typically one to bash products, but I have extremely normal skin - non-reactionary, non-sensitive, have used all types of products over the years. This serum caused a reaction I have never experienced - my skin became really dry and flaky and really tiny bumps developed under my eyes and around/below my lips. My eyelids specifically were bright red and flaky and I never put it on my eyelids. I asked around a bit after this reaction and numerous friends of mine said the same thing happened to them. I have used a handful of vitamin C serums (expensive & cheaper - CeraVe, Sunday Riley, Youth to the People, etc); I would not recommend this product as its not worth it to spend this much just to take a gamble with your skin.

I will preface this review and say I tried this product about 2 years ago and really liked it. My skin has since changed and become a lot more sensitive to harsh ingredients. Tula's ingredients are natural, but very harsh. If you have sensitive skin, avoid the entire brand, even their sensitive line! I purchased this product during the 21 days of beauty event knowing I had previously liked it. The first day I used it my skin got dry and itchy within a few hours. Halfway thru the day I was red and puffy. By the end of the day my skin was red, puffy, textured and hot. This was the worst allergic reaction I have ever had with a beauty product.

I have insanely sensitive skin now in my 40's, I am always nervous trying new skin care. However this brand and this product have become a staple for me. Been using consistently for almost a year now and I rarely, if ever need foundation anymore. I am very happy!

This was okay for me, I've used the whole bottle but never noticed any changes. I have acne-prone skin so a huge pro was how this product has no pore-cloggers, didn't break me out, or sting. However, I don't think I'll buy it again due to price.

extraits.titre: Love this! A HG for me
extraits.texte: I am 48 and have oily, sensitive, sun damaged, dark skin. I love this serum! Im on my 3rd bottle. I use it once daily after i wash my face at night and it just feels so good and makes my skin so soft. When i first started using it, other women complimented my skin which has never happened to me because Im usually so oily, which leads to breakouts. It doesnt have a smell which I prefer for my products to be fragrance free. I also like that 2 drops cover my whole face and neck so the 1 oz bottle lasts a good while. I do try to buy it when it is 1/2 off since its pricey. I tried a cheaper Vitamin C serum and it made my skin yellow (yikes) so I'm sticking with what I know works.

56 yr old skin that needed some brightness to my dull complexion. I use it in the morning before I put on my moisturizer, primer, and foundation. It works well under makeup and seems to brighten my skin. Would recommend.
I have been using this product for a year now and it has lessened my redness on my face.
